run_turk_pipeline_tool_C: run the full Mechanical Turk annotation pipeline for tool C with a given write directory
create_turk_job: create Mechanical Turk HITs from a CSV input file using an XML question template
get_hits_result: poll Mechanical Turk for completed HIT assignments and save results to a CSV file
construct_turk_input_csv: construct a CSV input file from newline-separated commands for tool C Turk jobs
collate_turk_answers: collate Mechanical Turk output data with input job specs into a processed CSV
